summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of 'Gestion des cartes etudiantes' feature in Administration. All 13 test cases passed successfully. The feature correctly implements: 1) Cards tab visible in Administration, 2) Formations list with Rh and Master Digital Marketing, 3) Students list with 3 students and stats cards (Etudiants, Cartes generees, Actives), 4) 'Editer les cartes' button, 5) Card editor with Recto/Verso toggle, 6 element buttons, variables list, calques list, 6) Default template with all required elements, 7) Verso with QR code and legal mentions, 8) Template save with success toast, 9) Template badge appears after save, 10) Generate cards dialog with template selector, 11) Cards generated for all students with student numbers, 12) Card preview with QR code and wallet buttons, 13) Public verification page shows 'Carte non trouvee' for invalid codes.

issues: Minor: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console - inherited from previous iterations)
